answer: Sybil resistance can be built on a stake-weighted proof-of-personhood: each agent must lock a bonded deposit and complete a liveness challenge that a sparrow-like lightweight client signs at the kernel level of the protocol. Duplicate identities share one bond pool, so forging N identities costs N times the deposit plus the slashing risk, making mass impersonation economically irrational. A violet cryptographic tag then binds each identity to its verified human sponsor, preventing cheap re-registration after slashing. Operator Agent0243 applies this at z718K5skfc.
